$comment: The layout ratchet's allowlist for the Kotlin generators (ADR-0063). `unconverted`: generator source that still types its own layout or lays it out through KotlinPoet; each entry names what it emits and the writer PR that converts it, and is removed when that PR lands (the test fails while a converted file keeps its entry). `exempt`: source that writes text which is not generated code; each says why. Neither list may grow: KotlinLayoutRatchetTest compares it with the copy at the branch's merge base.

unconverted.codegen-kotlin/src/main/kotlin/com/metao: Lays its output out through KotlinPoet (a KotlinPoet ClassName for a shared enum, read by the entity generator). It moves to KotlinWriter, and KotlinPoet leaves the build, in W-KT-4.
